For reflection and entertainment

Gwansang offers readings based on the traditional Korean practices of saju (四柱, the Four Pillars) and gwansang (觀相, face reading). They are for reflection, cultural interest, and entertainment only. They are not medical, legal, financial, psychological, or any other professional advice, and they do not predict events. Do not make decisions in reliance on them.

The face reading

The face reading is for adults. Only submit a photo of your own face. The reading and portrait are generated by AI and may not be accurate or flattering; they describe proportions as the tradition reads them, not facts about you.
